title: Another daemon owns this data directory
message: Another daemon (process {pid}) owns the data directory {path}.
basic_text: Rastai is already running with this data folder.
fix_text: Use the Rastai that is already running, or stop it first.

title: Database schema is newer than this app
message: The database {path} has schema version {version}, newer than this app supports.
basic_text: Your data was saved by a newer version of Rastai.
fix_text: Update Rastai.

title: rastai.db integrity check failed
message: rastai.db failed its integrity check: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai's index of your runs is damaged. Your runs themselves are safe.
fix_text: Run rastai storage rebuild-index.

title: Data directory not writable
message: The data directory {path} is not writable.
basic_text: Rastai can't save to its data folder.
fix_text: Check the folder's permissions, or set RASTAI_HOME to a folder you can write to.

title: vault.db integrity check failed; chat is off until it is recovered
message: vault.db failed its integrity check; chat is off until it is recovered.
basic_text: The file that holds your conversations is damaged, so chat is turned off for now.
fix_text: Recover the vault from its newest good snapshot.

title: Database read failed
message: A database read failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read its saved data just now. Your data is not damaged.
fix_text: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, check the disk.

title: The runtime folder or its daemon.lock isn't private to this user
message: The runtime path {path} isn't private to this user: {reason}. Nothing was written to it.
basic_text: Rastai's working folder could be reached by another user, so Rastai won't use it.
fix_text: Remove it, or set XDG_RUNTIME_DIR to a folder only you can open.

title: Blob hash mismatch; quarantined
message: The blob {content_hash} doesn't match its hash, so it was quarantined.
basic_text: A stored file was damaged, so Rastai set it aside.
fix_text: Download or produce the file again.

title: Referenced blob missing
message: The blob {content_hash} is referenced but missing.
basic_text: A file Rastai needs is missing from its store.
fix_text: Download or produce the file again.

title: Torn tail in an event log ignored
message: A torn record at the end of {path} was ignored.
basic_text: The last entry of a log was cut off, probably by a crash, so Rastai skipped it.

title: Event log corrupt: a bad frame before the end of the file
message: The event log {path} has a bad frame at byte {offset}, before the end of the file.
basic_text: A run's log is damaged in the middle.
fix_text: Report the problem with a bundle of the run.

title: Event sequence gap
message: Event sequence gap in {path}: expected {expected_sequence}, found {found_sequence}.
basic_text: Some entries are missing from a run's log.
fix_text: Report the problem with a bundle of the run.

title: Not enough free disk space
message: {operation} needs {needed_bytes} bytes on {volume}, but only {free_bytes} are free.
basic_text: Your disk is almost full, so Rastai can't save this.
fix_text: Free up space, or let Rastai delete old checkpoints and unused files.

title: Disk full during a write
message: The disk filled up during a write: {reason}.
basic_text: Your disk filled up while Rastai was saving.
fix_text: Free up space, then try again.

title: Storage quota exceeded
message: Rastai's storage quota is exceeded: {used_bytes} bytes used of {quota_bytes}.
basic_text: Rastai has used all the space you allowed it.
fix_text: Delete old files, or raise storage.quota_bytes.

title: Database snapshot skipped or failed; older snapshots kept
message: The database snapshot was skipped or failed ({reason}); older snapshots are kept.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't make today's backup of its databases. Older backups are still there.
fix_text: Free up disk space so the next snapshot can run.

title: Write failed for a reason other than a full disk
message: A write failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't save a file.
fix_text: Check the folder's permissions and the disk, then try again.

title: Storage, archive or secret command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: OS keychain unavailable; fallback store in use
message: The OS keychain is unavailable ({reason}); secrets are kept in Rastai's fallback store.
basic_text: Your system's password store isn't available, so Rastai keeps secrets in its own file.
fix_text: Unlock or install a system keychain to use it instead.

title: Archive database unreachable; retrying with backoff
message: The archive database at {host} is unreachable ({reason}); retrying in {retry_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't save to your long-term archive. Rastai keeps trying.
fix_text: Check that the archive server is running and reachable.

title: Archive schema needs a newer Rastai
message: The archive needs Rastai {min_writer_version} or newer; this daemon stops writing to it.
basic_text: Your long-term archive was upgraded by a newer version of Rastai.
fix_text: Update Rastai.

title: Archive connection without TLS refused
message: The connection to the archive at {host} has no TLS, so it is refused.
basic_text: Rastai won't send your data to the archive over an unencrypted connection.
fix_text: Turn on TLS on the archive server, or connect through loopback or a Unix socket.

title: Archive table doesn't report encryption; conversations are not archived there
message: The archive table {table} doesn't report encryption at rest, so conversations are not archived there.
basic_text: Your archive doesn't say it encrypts stored data, so Rastai keeps conversations out of it.
fix_text: Turn on table encryption on the archive server.

title: Archive credentials missing or rejected
message: The archive credentials are missing or were rejected.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't save to your long-term archive. The login was refused.
fix_text: Set the archive's user and password again.

title: Archive more than 24 hours behind; local pruning paused
message: The archive is {lag_hours} hours behind; local pruning is paused.
basic_text: Your long-term archive has fallen behind, so Rastai stopped freeing local space.
fix_text: Check the archive's status and connection.

title: Archived blob failed its BLAKE3 check
message: The archived blob {content_hash} failed its BLAKE3 check.
basic_text: A file in your long-term archive is damaged.
fix_text: Restore it from another copy, then verify the archive again.

title: Archived event frame failed its CRC check; restore stopped
message: An archived event frame of {run_id} failed its CRC check; the restore stopped.
basic_text: Part of an archived run is damaged, so it couldn't be restored.
fix_text: Verify the archive, and restore the run from another copy if you have one.

title: Prune refused
message: {item_id} can't be pruned: it is pinned, running, or not yet acknowledged and verified by the archive.
basic_text: Rastai won't free this item's space yet, because it isn't safely archived or is still in use.
fix_text: Unpin it or wait until it stops, or wait until the archive has acknowledged and verified it.

title: Archive purge needs admin credentials
message: Purging the archive needs admin credentials.
basic_text: Permanently deleting from the archive needs an administrator login.
fix_text: Enter the archive's admin credentials for this purge.

title: Archive migration waiting for another daemon's migration lock
message: The archive migration is waiting for the migration lock that {source_id} holds.
basic_text: Another Rastai is upgrading the archive, so this one is waiting.

title: Archive blob target unavailable or not writable
message: The archive's blob target {target} is unavailable or not writable: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't save to your long-term archive. Its file storage isn't reachable.
fix_text: Check the archive's file storage folder or bucket.
